THE HIGH COURT OF GUJARAT
NOTICE
C.0305/2023/CDSA/01 Ahmedabad,
February 22, 2023
RE: DESIGNATION OF SENIOR ADVOCATES.
It is notifed that, in accordance with High Court of Gujarat-
Designation of Senior Advocates Rules, 2018, Permanent Committee for
Designation of Senior Advocate has been pleased to invite Applications
seeking conferment of designation as Senior Advocates from retired Chief
Justices/ Judges of High Courts and Advocates in the prescribed format i.e.
Schedule II & I respectively. It is clarified that Advocates who have applied
during the last year and whose applications were not favourably considered,
shall not apply for a further period of 2 years.
Applications in the prescribed format i.e. Schedule I & II addressed to
the Hon'ble the Chief Justice of High Court of Gujarat, may be submitted in
the Secretariat of the Committee ('C' Branch of Administrative wing) latest
s[A. Raveendran]
Secretary
Committee for Designation of Senior Advocates
by 04:30 p.m on 18" March, 2023.
Copy to:-
1. The Secretary, Gujarat High Court Advocates Association (With request
to place it on the Notice Board of GHAA).
2. The Secretary, Bar Council of the Gujarat.
3. Notice Board.

GENERAL INSTRUCTIONS TO BE FOLLOWED WHILE FILLING UP "APPLICATION-
CUM-CONSENT LETTER" FOR BEING DESIGNATED AS SENIOR ADVOCATE
1. | Every Application-cum-Consent Letter, in the prescribed format shall be made inn English,
typed/printed with font size (Arial-12) in double spacing on one side of the white paper
(A4 Size) with an inner margin of about four centimeters width on top and on the left side.
2. |Documents accompanying the Application should be numbered consecutively in the Index,
in all sets of Application.
3. |All documents annexed to the Application should be accompanied by an Index containing the
details thereof. (The Registry, at any stage, may ask for the supportive documents for
verification in the light of the facts mentioned in the Application).
4. |Name of the Applicant should tally with his/her name as mentioned in his/her enrolment
certificate. Abbreviated name shall NOT be accepted.
5. |The Application should be presented in the shape of a Paper Book, duly tagged & indexed
and not in spiral binding and the like.
6. |All photocopies of the accolades/testimonials should be legible and true copy of their
respective originals.
7. |Required number of sets of the Application in the form of Paper Book, identical in all
respects, should be filed.
8. |Passport size photograph (original) should be pasted on each copy of the Application-cum-
Consent Letter.
9. |The Application should be accompanied by its soft copy in a searchable PDF format iina pen
drive. |
